`runserver` performs system checks explicitly in `inner_run()` (it sets `requires_system_checks = []` and calls `self.check()` by hand), so the generic `--skip-checks` option that `BaseCommand` adds for other commands never applied to it — there was no way to skip the 15–20s check pass on each dev-server reload.

**Docs** (part of the upstream change): `docs/ref/django-admin.txt` — mentions the option in the runserver section + `.. versionchanged:: 4.0` note; `docs/releases/4.0.txt` — release note under Management Commands.
